about: Sample lab reports written by Team ATLAS, not a real patient. Each row's truth is labeled by hand from what the report prints: high or low when the line is flagged or the value is outside the range printed on that line, inside when it is within that range, unknown when the line prints no range.

reports.title: Complete blood count
reports.layout: column table, flags spelled out (High / Low), units after the range
reports.text:

reports.title: Extra tests with tricky lines
reports.layout: a liter unit L, High Sensitivity in a name, values right on a < or > limit, a value printed as <0.2, a negative value, a (H) flag
reports.text:

rows.cautious: Our code shows this as can't tell on purpose: a lone L after the number may mean liters or Low, and only the AI calls it a unit. Counted apart from right and wrong.
